svg.title: BPE: merge the most common pair, then repeat
svg.desc: The words hug, pug, pun, bun and hugs, with counts 10, 5, 12, 4 and 5, split into letters. Three merges follow: u and g become ug (20 times), then u and n become un (16 times), then h and ug become hug (15 times). The vocabulary grows from 7 tokens to 8, 9 and 10.
svg.text: BPE: merge the most common pair, then repeat

g.text: b g h n p s u
top pair u + g, seen 20 times
top pair u + n, seen 16 times
top pair h + ug, seen 15 times

svg.text: Adapted from the Hugging Face LLM Course, chapter 6.5 (Byte-Pair Encoding tokenization).
